assumptions: Reference runner: generic, stdlib only (urllib + http.server). Model behavior of a real external service is nondeterministic, costs money, and rate-limits, so the runner drives an integration in sandbox/contract mode: it asserts the response contract (status, required fields present and correctly typed via dotted paths, forbidden fields absent) rather than calling the live third party. The reference ships a stdlib mock server (a conforming resource and a deliberately-violating one) so the contract logic, dotted-path resolution, and type checks are gate-tested with no live service, and an adopting repo points base_url at its own sandbox or contract-test endpoint. Shipped under plugin/templates/scripts/runners/integration/; not wired into the warp repo's own gate (capabilities: reference).
